name: Course Schedule
things_to_remember: Way 1: (DFS recursive) have a map with each course mapping to an array of prereq. Then for each course run dfs. Base case is if crs is in visited - false. if prereq array is empty - true. then loop through prereqs and run dfs again. after the loop, remove from visited, and make prereq empty
extra_notes: Way 2: (DFS recursive 2) have a map with each course mapping to an array of prereq. Then for each course run dfs. Also have a states array for each course state. 0 - unvisited, 1 - visiting, 2 - visisted. Base case is if crs state is visiting - false. if crs state is visited - true. then loop through prereqs and run dfs again. after the loop, change from visiting to visited

name: Course Schedule 2
things_to_remember: Basically same as above. Make dfs still return true or false. if not true, return empty. If loop finishes in dfs, add the current course to result

name: kth largest element in an array
things_to_remember: Similar to #1. Can be done with max heap and poll till we hit k. Or use a min heap and only insert if < size k (so min heap of size k)
extra_notes: Another soln: quick select: similar to quick sort - choose a pivot element (rightmost). Go through the array, if nums[i] is less than pivot, then swap with p otherwise keep as is. after the loop, swap pivot with p element. Then do it recursively till k == p. Average time O(n) but worst time O(n2)
